title: Synthetic graph and freshness conformance pilot
purpose: A bounded adapter and correctness conformance suite. It is not a held-out broad-accuracy benchmark and cannot support general superiority claims.

controls.inputPolicy: Symmetric explicit-symbol conformance track. Every participant receives the same subject/from/to path and symbol inputs, source state, result cap, timeout and refresh instruction. Questions are human-readable descriptions, not a claim of natural-language routing. Expected edges, result definitions and answers are evaluator-only.
controls.symbolLeakagePolicy: Only fields explicitly named subject/from/to/queryInputs are participant inputs. Expected fields never enter tool requests. No natural-language graph-routing score is reported.
controls.aggregationPolicy: Report each scenario independently. Do not pool these 12 scenarios with the development-only 100-query cohort or treat them as broad graph precision/recall evidence.
controls.failurePolicy: Timeouts, malformed output, stale incorrect output, and empty output are distinct artifact statuses. Operational success uses all 12 scenarios as the denominator. Unsupported scenarios are disclosed and are not silently removed.
controls.executionPolicy: Use isolated copies. Run participants serially. Preserve raw requests, raw responses, normalized answers, index/refresh commands, timestamps, and errors. No hosted indexing or repository upload.

write.payments/reports.py:
from .formatting import format_payment
from .audit import record_audit

def render_report(payment):
    rendered = format_payment(payment)
    record_audit(rendered)
    return rendered
